# PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic

> Evidence-based physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Multan, Pakistan — pain relief, injury recovery, and restored movement, delivered by licensed physiotherapists at the clinic or at your home.

PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic treats back pain, neck pain, sciatica, sports injuries, frozen shoulder, knee pain, and post-surgical and stroke rehabilitation. Led by Dr. Zain Ul Abideen PT and Dr. Jalal Ud Din PT.
